name: claude-mem
selectionPolicy: Expose claude-mem to Claude users as a pinned Firehorse marketplace dependency that installs the upstream plugin from its plugin/ subdirectory. Firehorse-pi also bundles the claude-mem npm package so Pi-only users have the worker scripts available without installing Claude Code. Do not merge the memory hooks, MCP server, worker scripts, or skills into the Firehorse Claude plugin; keep the original upstream runtime as the owner.
